game: BUF@HOU Week 12 2025, kickoff 2025-11-20 20:15 ET, NRG roof closed

script.base: Morning-of read only: HOU +5.5, total 43.5, implied BUF 24.5 / HOU 19.0, roof closed. C.J. Stroud is out, so Davis Mills starts a capped HOU pass game (Mills 7 carries/41 yards in weeks 9-11; HOU EPA/db -0.07 when blitzed vs 0.14 clean, and BUF blitzes 29%). BUF leads by about a score. Josh Allen stays efficient because HOU blitzes only 26% and his EPA/db is 0.32 unblitzed vs 0.11 blitzed. Late BUF leans run, but HOU's 3.96 YPC run defense (23 runs of 10+) plus Allen's own 15/91 rushing L3 keeps James Cook's yards modest despite 56 carries/215 yards over those three games. HOU still gives early-down work to Woody Marks (42 carries/134 yards L3) into BUF's 5.51 YPC front (45 runs of 10+), and when pressure comes Mills checks down to Dalton Schultz (28 targets/181 yards L3) instead of living on Nico Collins' 440 air yards.
script.flip1: Mills is cleaner than the blitz split and HOU hangs within a score or leads. The +5.5 dog throws more, Collins and Schultz both get volume, Marks' carries dip, and BUF has to pass (Shakir/Knox/Coleman) so Cook never gets a clock-killing fourth quarter.
script.flip2: BUF scores early (Jalen Pitre out helps Buffalo deep shots) and leads by 17+ at half. HOU abandons the run, Marks and Nick Chubb carries die, Mills' attempts spike in garbage time, and Cook's late handoffs come against a 3.96 YPC front that can still stuff a pure rush script.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and Marks under 27.5 lost the ticket because Buffalo led by three scores, Houston never got a second-half run plan, and Chubb or a hurry-up took the few carries Marks did get — his own 3.19 YPC says he does not create yards without volume, and a 19-point implied total can die in three-and-outs. Schultz lost because Mills, even while struggling, still forced the ball to Collins (36 targets L3, the clear first read) and the 24-yard floor in the last four showed up again, with no charted BUF linebacker missing to prove the middle was actually open. The counter-case is real but not stronger than the read: 27.5 still cashes on a reduced Marks role, and Schultz has cleared 45.5 in every week 9-11 game.

Those two win together in the base script and in a mild trail. Do not add Cook rush over, a game over, or Collins over — those need a different story. No TD legs. Two legs only.
